notes.claim: Separation of variables rearranges the equation so every term in the unknown is on one side and every term in the independent variable is on the other.
Radioactive atoms decay exponentially, at a rate that depends on the decay constant.
In an RC circuit the charge and discharge are exponential in time, and the time constant RC sets the pace.
When a coil's supply is switched off, its current falls to 0.368 of the preceding value in each successive time constant.
An exponential never exactly reaches its final value, but covers 0.632 of what remains in every time constant.
Reactor period is the time for reactor power to change by a factor of e, so a reactor's power grows exponentially (added for i2: the plus-sign example).
